key_reasoning.reason: A shared credential-lookup helper in src/providers/core/codemie-auth-helpers.ts (getPlatformUrlCandidates, getStoredPlatformCredentials and env variants) is adopted across many consumers: SSO provider (health, models, setup-steps), agent model-list resolvers (claude, gemini, codex, pi, kimi, copilot-cli, opencode-dynamic-models), codemie-code and opencode plugins, doctor AIConfigCheck, profile auth, skills require-auth and search client, and utils/sdk-client. Touching a core shared utility across several subsystems bumped this to XL.

Closest pattern is the existing single-URL SSO credential lookup (getStoredCredentials(codeMieUrl)). It does not cover the new multi-candidate profile-first then workspace fallback. That fallback is security-adjacent: an expired credential is deleted on a miss, candidates are deduped by origin, and only CodeMie providers treat baseUrl as the platform. CODEMIE_BASE_URL is deliberately not read because the proxy rewrites it to localhost. It is authentication-adjacent and has many edge cases (malformed CODEMIE_PROFILE_CONFIG, same-origin duplicates, non-CodeMie providers). Rollback is trivial and no schema or persistence change is involved.
36 files changed (1370 insertions, 130 deletions), about 18 source/docs files and 18 test files, across src/agents, src/providers, src/cli, src/utils and .ai-run/guides. The 16+ band maps to XXL.

Behaviour is uniform and consistent across all consumers: try profile URL first, then workspace URL. Implementation shows no open design questions. Scored S rather than XS because the provider-specific rule (only ai-run-sso/bearer-auth treat baseUrl as the platform) is a detail to confirm.
